modes.description: Reads and read-only commands run. Edits, other commands, web and MCP calls ask first.
modes.title: Ask before changes

modes.description: Also edits files and runs mkdir, touch, mv, cp and rm inside the working folders without asking. Everything else asks.
modes.title: Edit automatically

modes.description: Reads and read-only commands only. The agent writes a plan, and approving it switches to the mode you pick.
modes.title: Plan first

modes.description: A fast model reviews each action and runs it or pauses it for you. After 3 blocks in a row or 20 in a run, it asks instead.
modes.title: Auto review

modes.description: Reads run. Everything else is denied without asking.
modes.title: Don't ask

modes.description: Everything runs except critical commands, which ask first.
modes.title: Bypass permissions
